ballast.bulk_density_status: assumed: steel shot set in glue (~60% packing of 7.8)
ballast.fill_model: packed from the front of the bay; point mass at the fill's centroid

altered: fin thickness: membrane, root doubler, spar, ridges (manufacturing)
branched rays printed as one straight ridge each
removable paired fins with root tongues
paired-fin root edges trimmed to the body contour with a gap
pectoral incidence and pelvic incidence keys
hollow body with bay, port, drains
transverse catch slot under the head
eyes, gill covers and scales omitted
biological_constraints.kept: v3c outline, ray count, ray roots, angles and lengths, fin positions and dihedral

decisions_provenance: scale 1:1 and printed fins are ROOT's provisional engineering defaults under the user's request for a printable, strong-finned, sling-launched fish; size and material are not user-confirmed

export.right_parts: proper rotation of the mirrored fish-frame part (det +1); the flat print is the left part's mirror image

frame.handedness: right-handed Cartesian; with the snout facing -x and dorsal +z, +y is the fish's anatomical RIGHT side, so v3's _L suffix names the anatomical right

hand_neutral_point.method: Helmbold slopes on each pair (span incl. body), downwash 0.2-0.6, Munk k2-k1 0.80-0.95; hand estimate, not claimed

label: LAUNCH PROTOTYPE, UNTESTED: not printed, weighed, glided or thrown; printer and resin compatibility not claimed; all non-mesh numbers are provisional defaults.

boss_section.spans: the full shell width; bonded to the shell all round

launch_catch.kinematics: a forward band pull drives the loop up the slot's aft (bearing) face into the seat (the slot top or a plug's rounded underside); when the model outruns the band the loop slides down that face and out of the mouth. The recessed form of a rear-raked hook; claude-07's D1 should check it.
launch_catch.plugs: one part per (slot, lower offset); the top offset is the bare slot top; plug clearance 0.1 mm a side (assumed); retain with tape or a drop of glue
launch_catch.record_per_flight: slot x, seat offset (plug id), ballast, pelvic key

slot.across: full body width (band loop lies across the body)

mass_limit.status: claude-07 §0: V_trim <= 8 m/s at C_L 0.5 on 52.9 cm2 (hand number)

material.source: data/materials/formlabs-studio-2026-10-31.json @ f1796ec (root), Formlabs Alpha Grey V1 TDS
material.status: manufacturer-reported (default post-cure), provisional scenario resin; printer, cartridge and cure hardware unconfirmed

may_not_say: ready to print on a named printer
not_checked: slicing, supports, cupping and peel forces (PreForm's job)
fin stiffness or strength (claude-07's beam check reads these bytes)
aerodynamics beyond the hand estimates named in the manifest

ballast_bay.status: assumed; the loft range, clipped behind by the forward slot's axis plane (its liner is the bay's rear wall)

ballast_bulk_density_g_cm3.status: assumed: steel shot set in glue (~60% packing of 7.8)

catch.status: claude-07 R3 correction: seat at -1.5/0/+1.5/+3.0 mm from the design CG height, two arms ~15 mm apart; start tests at 0 and +1.5; slot shape, rake and plug fit assumed. r5: crown fairing (assumed geometry) = the liner's outer cylinder above the plane through the top seat perpendicular to the slot axis, carried across the body to flat end caps 0.5 mm outside the widest skin at that station, so the slot roof keeps the full 2.0 mm liner wall everywhere and the slot opens through square end caps instead of a feather edge in sloping skin

catch_zone_wall_check.status: r5 gate, fixed before the r5 build: an inward ray from every body face whose centroid lies within (liner radius + 3 mm) of a slot's x and above (top seat - liner radius); every wall reading (wedge < 45.6 deg, feather edges included) must meet the 0.45 mm rule; blunter corners are reported with their wedge angle, count and location

cg_window_mm.status: claude-07 first-print constraints for r3/r4 (v3c planform, SM 0.10-0.20 on the hand NP); replaces 44-60 mm, which came from v3a's planform; never aft of 54.1 mm before the VLM NP

decalage_keys_deg.status: claude-07 §1.3: keys at -1..4 deg; pelvic incidence = pectoral - decalage

default_decalage_deg.status: assumed nominal key for the assembled model

drain_holes.status: assumed; ventral; SLA hollow bodies need drains, size not validated

fin_body_clearance_mm.status: assumed gap between a removable fin's root edge and the body

main_cavity_x_mm.status: assumed; the loft range, clipped in front by the forward slot's axis plane

median_ridge.status: assumed: centred ridges on the dorsal, anal and caudal fins

min_wall_mm.status: provisional rule, sampled: the 0.5 mm design membrane less 0.05 mm for the sampler's float32 resolution; the Form 4 / Grey V5 0.2 mm guide is not taken as evidence for this printer or resin

nominal_cg_target_mm.status: claude-07 first-print constraints (provisional; the VLM replaces it)

pectoral_incidence_deg.status: assumed; leading edge up, about the fin's span axis

pectoral_spar.status: claude-07 R1 recommended section (height = total section depth from the membrane's upper face; spar under the membrane)

ridge.status: claude-07 R1: other rays as ridges >= 0.8 mm deep; 1.0 total chosen (provisional)

ridge_fillet_mm.status: claude-07 R1: r >= 1.0 where a ridge meets the membrane; built as a straight taper (chamfer-like), not a true radius

root_fairing.status: assumed: a block round each socket mouth, proud of the body (manufacturing alteration)

socket_clearance_mm.status: assumed per side; printer tolerance unknown; glue advised

parameters.title: r5 Daane catch fairing: r4 with a crown fairing over each catch slot (the slot roof no longer breaks out through the sloping dorsal skin) and claude-07's v3c CG window

tongue.status: claude-07 R1: keyed tongue >= 2 mm thick, >= 6 mm engagement (provisional)
